properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of text columns in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified TextColumns object.

properties.name: EvenlySpaced
properties.description: True if text columns are evenly spaced. Read/write Long.

properties.name: LineBetween
properties.description: True if vertical lines appear between all the columns in the TextColumns collection. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the Word art text effects, in points. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Spacing
properties.description: Returns or sets the spacing (in points) between columns. Read/write Single.

properties.name: FlowDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the direction in which text flows from one text column to the next. Read/write WdFlowDirection.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual TextColumn object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add([Width As Variant], [Spacing As Variant], [EvenlySpaced As Variant]) As TextColumn
methods.description: Returns a TextColumn object that represents a new text column added to a section or document.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the new text column in the document, in points.

parameters.name: Spacing
parameters.description: The spacing between the text columns in the document, in points.

parameters.name: EvenlySpaced
parameters.description: True to evenly space all the text columns be in the document.

methods.name: SetCount
methods.description: Arranges text into the specified number of text columns.

parameters.name: NumColumns
parameters.description: The number of columns the text is to be arranged into.
